purpose: Rank evidence packets for human research decisions. Never write, draft, promote, publish, or modify the content ledger.
guardrails: A high score is a prioritization aid, not a keyword-volume estimate or ranking prediction.
Every recommendation must retain its GSC rows, community signals, and technical-source links.
The job may not access Forge or any product source directory.
The job may not call a model, write a draft, or mutate public content.
Only a human may move a candidate into a research brief.
